about.title: About just practise
about.description: A desktop app for practising with your own recordings: play backing tracks slower or faster without changing the pitch, with a metronome, a tuner and a practice timer.
about.freeAndOpen: Free and open source, MIT license. No cost, no ads, no account.
about.contribute: Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue. Contributions are welcome, translations too.
about.components: just practise is built on these free projects. Thanks to everyone who works on them.
